units.source_text: 古歌：“对景即思人，交游过分亲。

en.t: An old poem says: When I face the scenery, I at once think of that person; our friendship had grown too close.

units.source_text: 只缘相处惯，暂别亦伤心。”

en.t: Only because we had grown used to being together, even a brief parting wounds the heart.
This appears in the Shui Wakashu.
